title: The Expo commands you'll type every week
prompt: Fill in the blanks so this terminal session creates Trailhead, starts the dev server, adds `expo-location` safely, runs the health check, and then builds a development build for the iOS Simulator.
hints: The project generator's package name is the thing you'd search npm for to create an Expo app.
Adding a native library uses the same verb as npm, but through `npx expo`.
Building locally for a platform uses `run:` followed by the platform name.
explanation: `npx create-expo-app@latest` scaffolds the project, `npx expo start` runs Metro, and `npx expo install` picks the library version that matches your SDK. `npx expo-doctor` checks for mismatches. `npx expo run:ios` compiles your own app binary (a development build) and installs it on the simulator, which you need once Expo Go doesn't have a native module you use.
